plan_items.text: Come back to the clinic in one week.
Bring your medicine bottles to the next visit.

clarify: Ask: does the pain spread to your arm, jaw or back?
Answer her worry about her heart.
Ask her to say the plan back in her own words.
summary:
You came in because of pressure in your chest. It started yesterday and gets worse when you climb stairs.

Your plan:
1. Come back to the clinic in one week.
2. Bring all of your medicine bottles with you.

Questions to ask next time:
- Does my chest pain spread to my arm or jaw?
- Is my chest pain from my heart? I have a stent, and I am worried.

Call for help right away if the pain gets worse, or if you faint or cannot catch your breath.
